newsitem.title: USA: Ashton Technology names top executives.
newsitem.headline: Ashton Technology names top executives.

text.p: The Ashton Technology Group Inc said on Wednesday that it named Robert Eprile as chairman and Fedric Rittereiser as president and chief executive officer.
The appointments follow the recent resignation of Raymond Tate, the company's former chairman, president and chief executive officer, said the company, which develops on-line transaction systems.
Rittereiser was also named as chairman of Ashton's subsidiary, Universal Trading Technologies. Eprile will remain as president and chief executive officer of Universal Trading.
Rittereiser was president of Instinet in 1984 and negotiated Reuters Holdings Plc's investment agreement in the company. Reuters later bought Instinet.
